Synopsis:
Group dialogue that happens when any of the hag survivors spots a player. Happens in hags survivors building, downstairs, where all of the survivros are gathered. Provides narrative explanation to players who are the survivors and what bothers them.Should not be repeatable!

- LOW_HagSurvivors_FirstMeeting_Adrielle_Kleidunn_Jatlo.json: This scene plays once when any hag survivor spots the player in the hag survivors’ building (downstairs), and the group is already tense and on edge. The survivors are frightened and paranoid because they believe a hag is hunting them; Adrielle acts as their protector and will react defensively toward any perceived threat. Off-screen, a redcap spy (Jatlo) may be disguised among the hags and has planted a voodoo doll to hex Mayrina (turning her into a sheep if she was present) or to pop up and torment the others — the doll’s creepy giggle and Kled’s panic explain the sudden alarm. If the players have already cured Mayrina or destroyed the doll, Jatlo can drop his disguise or immediately turn hostile and claim responsibility; otherwise he stays cold and accusatory, trying to deflect attention from the doll.

The hag support group is made up of people who have survived an encouter with a hag, and who have banded together to try to research hags, but also to be there for one another. However, one of their group (the dragonborn), is secretly a redcap and is toying with their minds. The redcap has also, if Mayrina is present, hexed her and turned her into a sheep. If Mayrina isn't present, the redcap has enchanted a doll that is terrifying the group.This dialogue covers a number of states such as 1) Mayrina is present and has been hexed 2) player cured her 3) player has saved Adrielle and the others from a redcap 4) the hag is dead and Adrielle rewards them (if no other npc is present) 5) if mayrina isn't present, a doll is terrorising them and she's trying to find it

context: This is a one-time group scene that fires when any hag survivor spots the player in the hag‑survivors’ downstairs meeting place; the survivors are already tense, paranoid, and convinced a hag is hunting them. Adrielle has taken on the role of their protector and will move to defend the group at the first sign of threat. Off‑screen, a disguised redcap spy (possibly Jatlo) may be present and has either hexed Mayrina (turning her into a sheep) or enchanted a voodoo doll that emits a creepy giggle — the doll’s noise and Kled’s frantic reaction explain the sudden alarm. If the player has already cured Mayrina or destroyed the doll, the spy’s behavior can change (he may reveal himself or turn openly hostile).
